text: Went there for the first time since it opened.  Overall the service was really poor, and quite frankly the food was only ok.  Was definitely over priced.  It's also quite annoying that their pints of beer are 14 ounces and not 16.  Not worth going back to this place.

I like to go to Joey Sherwood park for lunch with clients of dinner with my wife. Today I went for lunch with a client. We sat in the lounge near the bar at one of the high tables. It's usually busy but easy to get a table for lunch.
I like how consistent the food here is, I ordered the beach salad with candied pecans, strawberries, goat cheese and chicken. It was one of the best salads I have ever had. My favorite was the goat cheese.
I usually get the tuna salad with extra tuna, but I was glad I stepped outside the box today because it did not disappoint.

O...M...G....this place never fails you! Great prices, great staff and mouth watering food. The lettuce wraps are the perfect lunch with a side of sweet potato fries - *drool* and can't go wrong with steak and/or steak/sushi. Perfection every time!!

I feel that Sherwood Park gets shafted when it comes to quality restaurant selections. The old location of Joey was Ok but this new venue is amazing. And the service/food matches its level.

I have been here a number of times and each time the staff were pleasant and inviting. They are dressed classy and are accommodating to children...unlike another well-known restaurant in Sherwood Park.

The patio is huge and well placed. There is plenty of shade throughout a hot summer's day and the spacing between seating is great. You will feel really comfortable eating and relaxing out there.

The food as always is great. The last time I visited I had the Spanish Paella. WOW. Besides the plating style the combination of flavours with this dish was to die for. If you are up for a spicy dish that will warm you up and leave you full, give it a try. You will not be disappointed.

As a Sherwood Park resident, it's nice to see that Joey has made my city a permanent home. I really enjoy this place.
Good food, the bar area is a better place to sit for quicker service. Always seems to be a wait for the dining room.

Ate here for lunch on Monday while in town for work. There were only 3 of us and we all felt about the same regarding our visit. Atmosphere is great, and the food was really good as well. It wasn't very busy when we got there, but the service was clumsy and slow. I will say they were nice and friendly. It would be easy to rate this higher if the service was stepped up a notch.

I've been to a Joey's in Calgary and had a better experience.

Loved this place. They had great selection of beers. The service was quick and the waitress was knowledgeable about the food and friendly. I tried the appetizers and ofcourse had the main course. When I visit Edmonton I will definitely go here again

OMG, new favorite dish!! If you make it down, have the Spanish Paella... I have had paella at different restaurants and locations all over the world, and was blown away I could get one this amazing in my own back yard!! Kudos Joey's, we will be back...
Pretty good place. Great menu selection. Has gone a bit downhill with the staff since I first went there a year ago.  They uswd to have the hottest wait staff period. Definitely worth the stop in.

Joeys is always reliable. The menu is huge so no matter what you're in the mood for, you can probably find it here. Ask for the loaded crispy mashed potatoes as an appetizer. You'll be glad you did. The patio is really nice in the summer. It can be a bit loud, hence the 4 stars instead of 5.

Staff was very friendly.  Service was prompt.  The steak & sushi dinero was mediocre and superb respectively.  I eat a lot of sushi and the rainbow roll they served was top notch!  Had the soufflé and ice cream for dessert which was also a winner.  Would definitely return if staying in the area.

Good, but... 
The new location is great, much more modern, larger,  but with mostly the same menu. Service was prompt, we had a party of five,  and were seated in under five minutes, and had drinks shortly after. The server was great, taking our orders quickly and answering any questions. The food was hot and out within fifteen minutes. The only downside is that they've reduced the portion size of the various pastas. Definitely recommend the fettuccine chicken Alfredo. Overall very good.

I am a Hugh fan of Joeys, but this location is horrible!!!! I don't know what the problem is wotht the waitress's when they are serving my husband and I. We have come twice both with our children and the food comes out slow and burnt and then it takes for ever to get anything els let alone a napkin. I'm starting to wonder if it because my husband and kids are black. Anyway wont go back to this location.

Checked out the new patio, it's beautiful!

Was given two menus, one which was filthy. Told the sever so she took away the dirty menu and failed to return with a new one. The two of us tried to share the one menu. Finally had to ask for another to be brought out. 

The Caesar was fantastic as well as the gyoza. Tried the Ahi Tuna Club for the first time and it was amazing!! Will be back to order again. 

**Make sure you check your bill as an Ice Tea pop had been added on ($3 and change). When I pointed it out to the sever I was then questioned back "are you sure you didn't have one?" Really?  Usually get above average service from Joeys but not that day.
Pretty good food.  Most staff was nice, however you can tell some of the waitresses do not want to be there.

Still got a hankering after a movie?  I sure did, so we went to Joey's for dessert.  It was nicer inside than I expected, and the service was prompt.  They have an open concept lounge/ dining area, so it was harder to get away from the tvs.  The dessert (lava chocolate cake) was good, if a little pricey for the small cake.  Fortunately, I only wanted a small dessert, and by the time we were done, the richness of it convinced me it was big enough!

Friendly service, and a kitchen you can see into, which is kinda fun.

Came here with a table of 13 on Sunday! Service was alright (the woman was awesome, the man talked too much and wasn't attentive), food was awesome and overall it was a great dinner. I'm vegan and they accommodated me very well with a veggie Teryiaki rice dish and an avocado sushi roll to start. Delicious

Came here for late night dinner on a Thursday evening. No wait for a table - perfect.

The menu is still pretty late with a lot of options so depending on what you want to eat or are hungry for you could find something.

The food came out timely and the service was great!  If you're in the park and you're looking for somewhere to eat, Joey Tomatoes is a good choice.

For an upper end chain the food is great. Menu is diverse and interesting. Try the daily roast menu if you want a traditional meal. My new favourite is steak and sushi.  My go to is pesto flatbread.   One thing for sure is you won't leave feeling like you could have done better else where at this price point.

Ugh, what can I say about our experience at Joey Sherwood?  We "interviewed" this restaurant with my mom as a possible rehearsal dinner location, so I went in with a more critical eye than usual, but I would still say this restaurant is a dud. I spoke to the manager on the phone on Tuesday, and he agreed to meet us on Friday night at 6 pm, so we could talk to him more about booking the rehearsal.  When we showed up, the manager was gone for the day, and no one there had any idea we were coming.  A poor first impression, but forgivable.  

We were seated quite quickly (under 15 minutes) considering how busy it was.  The hostesses were very young and weren't all that friendly or professional; I'd chalk this up to bad training.  When I read the other reviews saying how loud the restaurant was, I thought "how bad could it be?"  It was LOUD.  I couldn't hear our server, and my mom couldn't hear half of what I was saying.  I was exhausted from practically shouting all night by the end of the meal.  

For our food, we tried to order a variety of dishes to sample what Joey's has to offer, so we got the chicken lettuce wraps as an appetizer, the lobster ravioli, the chicken and ribs and the fish tacos.  Our lettuce wraps were fantastic, and I wish I had stopped there.  My fish tacos were just terrible.  I love fish tacos and these were so greasy they were pretty much inedible.  The fish was deep fried, and the tacos were also served with aioli, cheese and guacamole (the guacamole was the only sauce listed on the menu).  All I could taste on the fish was the frying oil, and the two sauces in the cheese were also very rich.  I honestly wanted to send them back and order something else, but you know what?  Our server didn't return to ask how the food was.  He also didn't ask if anything was wrong at the end of the meal when my plate was fairly untouched.  My mom liked her pasta, and my fiancee thought his chicken was also too greasy to enjoy.  The lettuce wraps were great, but the incredibly loud environment, inattentive service and terrible food means I will never return.
Great service! We stopped in for a drink and an appetizer. We had the calamari which was delicious! I also had a cucumber cosmopolitan which was Awesome!

Lunch was superb. Great ambiance and
Excellent service. One small issue with one of our entrees which was promptly rectified by our server, Katelyn. She went way beyond our expectation. It is great to see that customer satisfaction is addressed by front line staff.
We shall return to enjoy again
Great place to get liquored by accident. That server "Braden" is a real stud, great hair. Food is very consistent.

Great place for dinner on my first night in town,  I went with the chefs Rotisserie Chicken and it was fabulous!  It was juicy and full of flavor.  The menu has a lot of options so there is something for everyone.

The staff is very friendly and the service was excellent!

I'd come back. I'm not from here but came on the recommendation of a local. And I was intrigued by the menu being slightly different (some Asian and some steak).  Definitely something different from say... Keg or Sawmill. Had the steak and sushi. And it was reverse happy hour, so had the sushi taco and the sushi cone.  I mean, it's not a sushi place but they did it well. And with some good beer.

This is a no-fail place to go for great food with amazing service. Seriously. We always go to the lounge and have ordered plenty of different dishes. 

My favourite dishes are the fettuccine Alfredo, the crispy mashed potatoes, the wings, and the ribs. I love that they still have the apple pie on the menu after all these years. 

I would love to give it five stars, but it's just not a five star restaurant. Four stars is high praise for a chain restaurant.

Out in Sherwood Park for a little date night. 
Service was phenomenal (Sydney). She gave great suggestions and made the experience that much better! 
We tried the Beach salad + the Joey stab at sushi. Food was good. Came out prompt. What you would expect from Joey. Always consistent. Beer was cold and wine was on point. 
Really dig the open lounge and new design of the interior. 
Would definitely recommend this to anyone out and about in Sherwood Park!
This was my favourite restaurant but now they've taken off Caesar salad I enjoyed the chilli chicken I wish you would put back the Caesar salad I miss it

This is one of the more enjoyable restaurant  experiences in Sherwood Park. 

Out of the Cactus Club, Earls, and Joeys family I think Joeys food is the worst of the three. That goes for this location as well. One time I had the pesto shrimp flatbread and the dough was obviously not completely cooked. There are no great options to choose from, especially when it comes to desserts. That all being said the food is decent enough. 

I don't go to Joey's for the food, but in Sherwood Park if you are looking for somewhere that feels like you're going somewhere cool this may be a good place to try. The lounge is quite large and spacious so it never feels too crowded. Sometimes on weekend evenings there can be a bit of a wait for a table.

I am a fan of all Joey's locations because the food, drinks, and service are always good. That being said, I would still recommend this place but  this location doesn't seem to have the same atmosphere or decor that the other Joey's have. Its more like they just wanted to get as many people as possible in the building. The main area is pretty much just a big open area filled with tables and when you push your chair back to stand up, it will likely be hitting a chair at the table behind you. Get the picture? Anyways, make sure to check out their drink menu when you go.

Atmosphere:  very loud and the tables are very close together, both inside and on the patio.

Service:  Prompt and polite, but occasionally too casual.  very slow to refill water.

Menu:  varied dishes, so a great place to go with people who all want something different.  there could be more gluten-free AND vegetarian offerings besides just salad.

Food:  tasty and nicely presented.

First time to this new location and we had a great time enjoying our after movie snacks, drinks and speciality coffee. The server truly was wonderful and had us in good banter and left us laughing throughout the evening.

As we had our full on movie popcorn, we decided to share lettuce wraps (both shrimp and chicken) and hot wings. Perfect amount of food for the four of us. I really appreciated that there truly was enough lettuce to make wraps but for those that can't have the noodles be forewarned that they are mixed in with the chicken or shrimp. For me this was fine but for my friend on a diet it made it a bit more challenging to get to the good stuff she wanted. The coffee afterwards was actually why we had decided on joeys, as it's from BC and the satisfaction on everyone's faces said it all. 

The building itself is nicely laid out and even though the restaurant side was fairly full we had no problems taking to each other. There's lots of windows so where we say we could enjoy watching the sun set. I also appreciated the fact there was a ramp and stairs to get into the restaurant, as it's set lower than the bar. Lots of parking and plenty of handicap stalls too.

Definitely will be back here again as it's a great place to hangout and grab a quick bite or enjoy a nice meal.

Very nice new location. The lounge is much larger and more sunlight than the old one. A few different me u items but still delicious. I have to recommend the apple pie! It is made on the spot and is so delicious! I had mine with caramel and icecream . Pretty sure next time I come I am going to order the apple pie for supper and dessert!

Went for apps last night and was surprised to find the place deserted!  Fortunately we found out that They moved to a new location a few steps away. Wow!  What a transformation!  Beautiful decor. Great atmosphere. Nice background music not too loud. 

Sat in the bar and a beautiful log table and enjoyed lettuce wraps, Korean cauliflower and a Mediterranean plate. All delicious. But the cauliflower was so good we ordered a second plate!  

Server Jo was fantastic. 

About $25/person for appetizers excluding wine. Wine is $8-12/glass. A bit expensive but worth it if you want a more upscale place.

I came here for a supper with my mom and future MIL. It was a little louder than I would have liked but it was my fault for not knowing the atmosphere. My dinner of sliders was really tasty, but my MIL's meal came quite undercooked and not to preference, we're talking food safety here. My mom and I awkwardly ate our meals at her insistence. By the time her meal came, we were both finished. Our server was exceptional though. The atmosphere and kitchen just weren't up to standards.

We went here for dinner while visiting in Edmonton. The restaurant is very spacious but also very loud. We were seated quickly and the food came out in a reasonable time frame. Our drinks were refilled and the server was pleasant enough. When it came time to go I had to go get the server and ask for the bill so I guess they only care about you as long as you are eating. The food was flavorful and not bad for the price. They had some interesting local beers on tap which was a hit with the beer lovers in my group. Overall I'd say a good choice for a quick meal before a movie or a night out with your friends.
Good food, especially liked the sparkling juice drinks with free refills. Just wonderful.

Well we headed out tonight for some yum,  and Stella was on special, on tap. Yeah :)P    Its a busy place, service was good , and the food yummie.
I had the Panang Prawn Bowl, with noodles, I was told I could pick whatever noodle I wanted or rice, and I picked the fettuccine noodle, it was smaller than the usual fettuccine noodle I usually get in a pasta dish, Hubby got  the California Chicken Club and he liked it , nice and lite and both our dishes didn't bloat us up which means more of the Stella  Artois on tap that we love. Unfortunately dessert was only three choices on their menu, and it didn't really tantalize our taste buds much.  If they had a better choice menu in desserts, and more to choose from then the three they offered that, were pretty basic-- desserts I would have given a 5*.

Service was wonderful atmosphere was pleasant my only complaint is that my meal was horrible and because I was polite I was still charged the full price even though I didn't eat it. I ordered the ahi tuna club sandwich, it read very well on the menu, but the presentation was a greasy drive-in burger. The tuna was bitter and very thin. I suggested it be removed from the menu or replaced with a gourmet hamburger because that is what it was like is a hamburger not a tuna entree. Will I go back? Probably. However, I will never order that dish again, nor will I feel I have to be overly polite to have my bill compensated for a bad dish.

We had made reservations for 6 people at 11:30am last week for our business lunch today.
I was second to arrive for our reservations and the place was already busy in both lounge and dining area. 
My company started arriving at around 11:40-11:45am, so I was happy because I was hungreee....
Once we were all there everyone ordered their drinks and food at the same time because we need to be out by 1:00pm or earlier to catch our next meeting.

While waiting and having small talk I tried to take photos of the restaurant without being too obvious. The place is smaller than the South Common location in Edmonton but it still has the Joey's trade mark look, an upscale lounge with good looking employees. It brings me memories of when I was in school and was a server... hmmm the fun good 'ol days...lol

About 45 mins went by and no food, my stomach started making noises. I feel my colleagues getting a bit antsy (this is not good). Our server came by and told us that the lounge patrons had ordered just before us and that is why our lunch is taking too long.

By the time our food arrived it has been about an hour if not longer.

I ordered the BBQ Salmon bowl with brown rice and my colleagues had lettuce wraps, salads, and ravioli. The food looked amazing! I can't complain about the food, my salmon bowl was delicious and everyone else was happy with their meal.

My only complaint was the service was extremely slow ( we did not leave until 1:20pm) but it was not our servers fault I can see the cooking staff was crashing. It was a busy lunch rush so I'm still giving a 3.5 star but closer to 4 star.

I would come back here but not if I had important plans after because it's more of a place to relax and enjoy a few drinks plus eat yummy food. 

Next time I'm sitting in the lounge!

Have been here a few times, tonight the experience was even better than usual. Fantastic attentive service, a delicious rainbow roll appetizer, I enjoyed their version of Spanish paella with shrimp, chorizo and chicken, and loved how the rice had a crispy flavourful crust to it. Delicious. Started with the Wood Buffalo IPA and then a tasty Jumilla red. Very nice evening :)

So we start off by being told it's a 20 minute wait.  It's been close to an hour.  You know when you make people wait that long for food and continually being told "only a few more minutes" it doesn't do you or your new restaurant in the new building location any good...and puts all the more pressure on the service and food team to deliver a perfect experience. 

Add insult to injury, the people right before us were offered a free appetizer...I didn't bother asking for one. 

This being said, once we were seated it was fairly quick to get our orders taken and service was good. I had the Rotisserie Chicken which was presented well and was excellent. 

Joey's if you are listening...be honest with your customers.  If it's going to be a 55 minute wait tell your customers.   Have a policy in place that lets your staff offer a free appetizer for any guests waiting for longer than 30 minutes.  This will go a long way to keeping a loyal customer base. 

I may be back.  But if I see a long line of people I may decide to check out one of the many restaurants near by.

Went for dinner at Joey tonight, had never been before. What a great place. From the moment I walked in, the hostess was prompt to seat me and then very shortly there after my server came up and introduced himself (Noah) and He asked if I would like something to drink. Started out with the lettuce wraps with chicken as an appetizer, and for my entrée I enjoyed the shrimp Penang. Both were just Delicious!  The whole experience of this restaurant was five star, but I have to say Noah was one of the best servers I've ever dealt with. Often when you dine alone you can be easily forgotten about but never for a second did he make me feel that way, so if you get the chance,enjoy this great restaurant with great food and outstanding service.

We were looking for a great place to eat in Sherwood park.  ..we found Joeys Sherwood Park.
The food was perfection .....the  amazing blend of flavours in the house salad was truly one of the best we have had the pleasure to treat our taste buds....
The peppercorn new York steak Was perfect....soft....juicy. ....super tasty...done exactly as I ordered......and the filet was absolutely excellent, the best I have ever eaten cross Canada,  the beurre blanc suggested by our waitress was better than all the bernaise sauces I have ever tried.
The service matched the outstanding food.....
One if the best dinning experiences we have had in 30 years. ....thank you

I had a wonderful lunch at joeys the other day, it's a great spot to meet up with friends for a meal or a drink. I had a grilled chicken sandwich with a house salad. I am very picky about my chicken and it was cooked perfectly just the way I like it! The waitress was nice and checked on us a few times to make sure our meal was going well. They have great giant booths in the lounge area that lends more of a private dinning experience so also a great date night location! I have noticed the menu items have gone up in price recently but it's still a great place to enjoy some time out.

Came here for Mother's Day, the place was semi busy.  More on the restaurant side with families and kids. We sat right away on the bar side (wasn't busy). There were tons of servers walking around and took about 10 minutes before anyone came over to give us menus. Took another 20 minutes before we even got our drinks, the bartender was clearly swamped as he was alone behind the bar. Our drink sat there another 10 minutes before a server dropped of our drinks. I would just suggest management plan out staffing a bit better. Food took about 35 minutes to come out, was really good. Overall, it was just really disorganized and you could tell they were either short staffed or didn't plan out the schedule very well. Our waitress was very pleasant for being so busy. 

I gave it four stars as I've been here before during a weekend and it was much better service. You can tell it was just an off day since it was Mother's Day.

mmmm.....Steak.  I love the Joey chain.  When I found out we were going for a work lunch at Joey Sherwood I was absolutely ecstatic.

I haven't been here in a number of years, so I was very impressed with the renovations.  The ambience is really great.  Nice, subtle lighting and a calm buzz of tables around you.

The service was really great too.  There was 7 of us and none of our beverages were ever empty.

Most of my guests ordered Steak and Sushi, which is new to the menu.  I'm not into sushi so I didn't join them, but it looked amazing and everyone seemed incredibly happy with it.

I went with the steak frites.  It was a perfect medium rare.

Oh, I do love a good steak.
I came here for lunch and nothing stood out in particular...I had the veggie burger and it was decent

My party was in the lounge, The appetizers for happy hour were fantastic.  However, the service was terrible.  Waiting for a long time for service.  First time I ever left a restaurant hungry due to waiting and the waitress not really caring if we ate.

Food was sub par for the price, things move at a snails pace for service. Was not impressed for a new venue.

Won't be back

Very disappointing experience at Joey Sherwood.

We made 7:30 pm reservations and once we arrived we asked the hostess if we could sit on the patio.  She said we could but there would be a wait of about 30 minutes but we could sit in the bar and have a drink while we waited. Sounded good.

After approximately 45 minutes I went to the hostess to check on our table.  She said there still wasn't anything available.  I mentioned that we were told it would be about 30 minutes and we had now been waiting approximately 45 minutes.  She responded back that I had only been waiting 40 minutes because she has a timer.

After approximately 60 minutes we were texted by the hostess to inform us that our patio table was now ready.  We were seated at a table right next to the bar entrance doors in a corner.  A quick scan of the patio showed there were 5 empty tables.  We moved to a nicer location near the centre of the patio.

Our server asked how our evening was and we told her that the experience wasn't the best so far but we were looking forward to her changing that for us.  She apologised for the delays and our Joey experience and said that she would do her best.  We appreciated that as up to that point it wasn't her fault.  Her next question to us was did you pay for your drinks in the bar?

She took our drink order and asked if we were ready to order.  I asked if she could come back in just a couple of minutes.  My mistake.  Another server brought us our drinks and our server didn't return to take our order for about 15 minutes.

Our food did come in a timely manner and was delivered by another server.  Everything was good except for a mix up on my yam fries.  Our regular server  quickly told us that it wasn't her fault.

We ate our dinner, didn't get a food quality check and were asked if we wanted to see a dessert menu.  We pass on dessert and just asked for our bill.

Our server brought our bill and let us know she told the manager of our Joey experience.  I looked at our bill and nothing was adjusted to reflect our experience...nor did I expect there to be.  She asked if I wanted to chat with the manager.  I said if you had already told your manager and they didn't feel it was important enough to come speak with us then there really wasn't any point.

As we left the restaurant we did run into the manager and let him know of our experience.  I asked if his patio server had told him of our disappointment with our dining experience.   He said he wasn't told there was a problem.  He offered to give us a gift certificate but we declined as we wouldn't be interested in coming back.

Joey Sherwood, you let us down on so many levels.  Snarky front end host, lengthy wait times on a late evening Wednesday night, and no apparent communication between staff and managers.

I personally would not recommend this restaurant to anyone.  Economic Development and Ottawa Tourism were not impressed by their experience.
The atmosphere is great and the service imo is very good. The staff is friendly and the food is always top tier.

My boyfriend and I like going to Joey on Jasper and were in Sherwood Park the other night and decided to check out the "Joey Tomato's" there. 

The restaurant is elegantly decorated with low-lighting. A little more dated interior and much older crowd than the Jasper Ave one. 

The service was highly attentive and friendly. Well-dressed, well groomed staff from the front of house to the manager who came to double check on my almond allergy :) 

We only had water to drink and a hostess took our drink order before our waitress came to the table. 

We ordered salads and they came in large portions with dressing on the side as requested. 

We'll be back for sure. 
Love the service at Joey!

Service was great, food really not so much. The 500 Salad with Chicken came out and the chicken was severely undercooked, with an undercooked smell and slimey with pink on the inside. We are not the kind of people to send food back, but as the chicken is mixed in little pieces through out and we were grossed out by the smell of raw chicken asked for the salad again by itself without any chicken or protein. Portion was quite small for a full size entree. Pecan salad at Cactus would be preferable. Baja Tacos not comparable to Local. Itty pieces with an offputting texture, tasted like something out of a frozen bag, (and way way too salty), could have been too much salt mistakenly added to last nights batter not entirely sure. Again not the kind to send food back but had the chicken not already been undercooked and sent back, otherwise even so, I probably would have. Ate one of the tacos to try and be polite as it was a birthday dinner, the table all tried half the second taco and agreed it was way too salty, the rest got thrown out when everyone else finished. We did not have it in us to send a second entree back. The tandoori or butter chicken and bbq salmon bowl our table ordered were said to be great.  The service and Desserts were great, manager came out and apologized and stated it had something to do with the cut of meat, but undercooked  chicken,is undercooked chicken. Server was great on her part, not sure what happened in the kitchen, maybe someone is new and training, things happen. Otherwise great service and perhaps a two out of five off on entrees and great desserts. Can't say I'd personally return.
Food was good, service was horrible. Took forever to get anything or to have our order taken, which was weird because there was a separate person dropping off drinks, food and clearing dishes.

.... " Sherwood Park's sexiest rotisserie half-chicken "...

A hip, urban chic and very casual dining experience awaits at the Joey location on baseline Road in Sherwood Park.  The chain truly understands combining high ceilings with understated, ultra-elegant decor that makes swanky yet low key sensory experiences enjoyable and very accessible for its patrons. 

We were immediately taken to our seats after the very enthusiastic hostess greeted us and took our drink orders to get going. As you sit down, you are taken back by the pleasant atmosphere: lounge disco beats on the speakers while looking at the giant dark metal chandeliers, lamp posts, vintage neon car displays and a unique brick treatment pattern on the walls; definitely memorable.

For the food, Joey has a revamped seasonal menu and it has global fusion twists  that  included some Asian and continental cuisine influences.

We started with a fantastic Pesto Shrimp Flatbread ($15) which consisted of broiled shrimp on a flatbread with whole milk mozzarella, sun dried tomatoes and Chipotle aioli.  

Next came a bowl of the mushroom soup ($7.75) that was extremely tasty with its generous portion and various mushroom chunks that were screaming home made and was not heavy.

For the mains, we witnessed "Sherwood Park's sexiest rotisserie half-chicken" with angry bird rub served with roasted vegetables and brown rice ($25.50) 

Our Spanish paella came on an impressive cedar plank charged sizzling cast iron skillet ($23.50).  The dish that has chicken, shrimp and chorizo sausage gets its seafood contribution from a yellow saffron lobster broth that made the rice base absolutely terrific and not "saucy".  The flavors were decadent with every bite!  

The very attentive staff came to check on us regularly without being intrusive and drink refills were timely and predictive, something rare in casual eateries.

Overall, an excellent value for the experience.  When looking at the terrific decor, super enthusiastic  staff, great food and wow factor ambiance; Joey's Sherwood Park hits the spot!

Was finally able to drop in again after a few months, and sat in the bar area. They have installed glass partitions between the high top tables so covid protocols are in place and it feels pretty safe. The staff are masked up, but many are using the clear plastic shields for safety. Our fave server Nicole had returned and it was so great to see her again. She is one of the most pleasant people I have ever met and takes care of you as if you were a guest in her home. She's delightful, funny, kind and completely lovely. If you have the good fortune to be looked after by her you will have a superb experience. Drinks were amazing as they always have top notch bartenders on staff. This is one of the only places I can get perfect mixed cocktails, martinis and old fashioneds.

It's a modern metro restaurant lounge.  Food is decent and varied.  Servers are pleasant.  Upscale feel.  Bright windows.  Booths and tables.  They even have sushi.  The patio is nice. You have to touch it to pay and turn the machine over and tap the back to pay. Not practical compared to other credit card machines. It is popular and can be busy. Nice spot.

My friends And my husband come here often for cocktails and dinner or appies and we usually sit in the lounge. We have a great time, talk all night, drink delicious cocktails and whiskey and enjoy appies. 

The service is always impeccable! But like, real. I don't know who does the hiring and management here for the last couple years, but the staff is always amazing. 
They're fun, engaging and natural (I hate canned grins and fake questions for small talk from servers.) 
The servers at this Joey location are always laid back, but professional- know when to join a conversation and when to leave a table be. Are able to crack a joke and read the table to give some ribs and are able to laugh. 

The food at Joey is great for the price and the room. It's consistent. (I wish they'd use Nori to wrap the sushi.)

But I honestly find myself returning to this restaurant and inviting friends to join for a new place for them to check out because I can count on the rockstar staff. 

Just this evening, we were seated in the dining room because the lounge was full. It was just my husband and I. It was late night. About 9:30. 
Our server was a guy named Moe. He was so engaging I wondered if he was the manager or owner the place. He approached our table, made genuine eye contact, smiled, and took our orders like we were at an exclusive fine dining experience. 
He was well dressed and well put together - but I've honestly never seen a server take his role so professionally in a restaurant in Edmonton. He clearly loves and respects what he does but also strives to make sure his diners are given exemplary service. His timing to the table was perfect, he was active and engaging the whole time and made us feel valued and gave our little night out of happy hour wine and lettuce wraps the feeling like we were at an exclusive restaurant. 

Joey is a great chain. I like it a lot. 
But Joey Sherwood separates itself from the rest with its record of always having a rockstar crew of dynamic servers.

We came here on a weekday holiday for lunch, it was quite busy and we had to wait about 15 mins for a table, which isn't too bad. It was a spur of the moment decision, but next time I'd definitely make reservations.

Our server Alex was very helpful and polite, great service. I ordered a German Riesling which was very nice. I've always found German wine to be very underrated. My husband ordered a decaf coffee which smelled amazing, like hazelnuts or something...Mmm.

For our meals I ordered the Chicken teriyaki rice bowl, it was so delicious! Warm sushi rice, with veggies and grilled chicken. Topped with sesame seeds. It had a lovely hint of spice, but not too much, which is exactly how I like it. Hubs had the cheddar bacon burger, which he said was delicious as well. It looked really good, and the fries were nice too. It was a very nice weekday lunch date.
Order a chicken Alfredo to go,  I got literally about 50 noodles worth, no chicken, and no Gaelic bread to boot.... What the fuck did I pay 18$ for? Bullshit I guess.

I'm a regular to Joey Sherwood and always have a great experience. This last Friday night was an exceptional experience.  I mentioned to the GM that I had not had a steak at Joey for 5 years because I didn't enjoy them. He let me know that I've been missing out on some of the best steaks anywhere. He brought the chef to my table to explain the high quality of steaks that are exclusive to Joey and encouraged me to take another look.  I had the Peppercorn New York and was very pleased with the result.  I now have my new steak place. I would recommend their steaks to anyone.
Great experience! I thoroughly enjoyed the New Cobb Salad with 6" steak, but make sure you ask for Katanya!

Not buying hype...
Sat down with two kids for lunch...and our story begins.
My appologies in advance for the unabridged version!

Hostess went to get a booster seat only to return informing me they only have high chairs...which attatch to table. Not ideal for my short 5 year old. Strike one for confusion on her part and poor equipment choices on managements part.
Next...
No official childrens menu. Ok. Fine. I guess it's not entirely family friendly. Informed by server however that they do offer several kids options. Grilled cheese, chicken fingers, or kids sized pasta with either tomato or alfredo sauce. 
Put menus asside...waited for a while. A new gentleman appeared to take our orded. This is the third person to help us. I don't like such confusion.
Ordered the grilled cheese and pasta with marinara. I ordered Ahi Tuna buger.
He went to kitchen to confirm marinara. Returned with news it was only tomato sauce. Fine. That'll do.
5 minutes later...he returns to tell me...and my uncomfortably seated 5 year old that it turns out they do not have the tomato sauce at all.
Good grief. It shouldn't be this hard to feed the kids.
I inform him that we will settle on a FREE order of kids pasta with alfredo sauce.
He agrees.
Now...we wait for food...
Not bad.
Kids pasta not bad...but not worth the $7 they charge.
Grilled cheese. Reasonable value.
Ahi Tuna burger...pretty good.

Overall. Ok food.
At least 4 people "helped" us. Not entirely sure who my server was.
I don't think my family and I will be back for a long time.

First visit to this location,  Sister had purchased gift certificate for Mom and  wife and I.  Ambience was nice and they seemed to be clean, compliant in all the rules and regulations.  I like the open kitchen concept, entertaining if you are close enough to watch.  Location was reasonably full, good to see, for a 6:15 reservation.  Reservation was on time and set up ahead for us and appreciated.  Initial service and drinks were prompt.  Food was delivered in a timely fashion and delicious.  Everybody enjoyed their selections.  There were only a couple of very minor missteps by the server but corrected quickly.  Overall, a pleasant experience.
Dropped one star as I felt, for the price point, the portions could be a bit larger.
This is a staple in our home. We always know where we are eating out. Everything is so good here. Never a bad meal. The lettuce wraps, katsu chicken salad, the burgers, and service. Unbelievable.
